neighbours.label: the clause keyword that opens a branch of a conditional block in code: SQL 'WHEN' in 'CASE <column> WHEN' and indented Python 'except'
fire: UPDATE orders SET flag = CASE region WHEN 'EU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
SELECT id, CASE grade WHEN 'A' THEN 'top' WHEN 'B' THEN 'good' END FROM marks;
UPDATE staff SET bonus = CASE level WHEN 3 THEN 500 ELSE 0 END;
SELECT CASE color WHEN 'r' THEN 'red' ELSE 'other' END AS c FROM items;
UPDATE users SET tier = CASE plan WHEN 'pro' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END;
SELECT name, CASE dept WHEN 10 THEN 'sales' ELSE 'ops' END FROM emp;
quiet: UPDATE orders SET flag = 1 WHERE region = 'EU';
SELECT id, grade FROM marks WHERE grade IN ('A', 'B');
UPDATE staff SET bonus = 500 WHERE level = 3;
SELECT color AS c FROM items ORDER BY color;
